# Lavendar Lewis & Stephen Irving

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Romantically involved with — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Spouse of — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — married in a ceremony · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> During breakfast, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the situation with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), all while managing Davy's lively table manners. [Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to help [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) make an [Indian](../codex/factions.md#indian) headdress using old feathers. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund that ensures the twins can remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and they spend an enjoyable evening sharing stories, tea, and candy. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) opens up about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to suggest bringing his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), for a visit. A month later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) introduces [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two quickly form a warm and fond connection.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

> After school finishes for the year, town mothers discuss Anne's departure for college, the upcoming loss of Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's unique imagination. [Anne](../character/anne.md) stays at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), then meets [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and learns he wants to reconnect with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly helps arrange their reunion, helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare as [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to see Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) lets him in to reunite with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) wait anxiously in the kitchen until they see [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walking together outside with his arm around her, confirming their reconciliation.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) visit [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to help [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden in front of their guests, after which everyone sees them off at the station. While locking up the stone house afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, poignant moment that subtly alters the nature of their relationship as they look toward their college years.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
